entity_raw.definition_raw:
You land precise attacks from afar.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13; Combat Expertise or brawler’s cunning class feature; Lunge; Outslug Style; Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.

Benefit(s): While using Outslug Style, you don’t take a –2 penalty to your AC when using the Lunge feat. The bonuses to AC and on weapon damage rolls that you gain from Outslug Style increase to +2.
